title: Canonical proper/open comparison morphism for higher ind-images
statement: Under the hypotheses of lem-zl-ind-proper-open-higher, for every K in the ambient ind-heart over X and every n there is a canonical morphism from Rⁿp₁*(j₁!K) to Rⁿp₂*(j₂!K), and this morphism is an isomorphism.

source.place: Proper/open exchange comparison before packaging as a Nonempty isomorphism.

proof.text: Construct the proper/open exchange map as the adjunction mate of the normalized open restriction comparison, and transport it through the normalized ind-extension.
Use proper base change on the open and closed restrictions, exactness of open extension, and the Grothendieck right-derived comparison to prove the comparison morphism is invertible.

mathlib_searches.results: Existing native and étale exchange theorems are upstream but no ind-heart theorem matches.

lean.statement:
theorem zlIndWeilProperOpenHigher_comparison
    {X₀ Z₁ Z₂ Y₀ : Over (Spec (.of D.k₀))}
    [LocallyOfFiniteType X₀.hom] [QuasiCompact X₀.hom]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType Z₁.hom] [QuasiCompact Z₁.hom]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType Z₂.hom] [QuasiCompact Z₂.hom]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType Y₀.hom] [QuasiCompact Y₀.hom]
    (j₁ : X₀ ⟶ Z₁) (j₂ : X₀ ⟶ Z₂)
    [IsOpenImmersion j₁.left] [IsOpenImmersion j₂.left]
    (p₁ : Z₁ ⟶ Y₀) (p₂ : Z₂ ⟶ Y₀)
    [IsProper p₁.left] [IsProper p₂.left]
    (r : Z₁ ⟶ Z₂) [IsProper r.left]
    (_hi : j₁ ≫ r = j₂) (_hp : r ≫ p₂ = p₁)
    (n : ℕ) (K : zlIndWeilHeart D l hl Ω X₀) :
    ∃ e :
      ((zlIndWeilPush D l hl Ω p₁).rightDerived n).obj
          ((zlIndWeilOpenShriek D l hl Ω j₁).obj K) ⟶
        ((zlIndWeilPush D l hl Ω p₂).rightDerived n).obj
          ((zlIndWeilOpenShriek D l hl Ω j₂).obj K),
      IsIso e
